meta.name: internal-controls-and-audit
meta.description: Designs and tests controls over financial reporting — segregation of duties, approval limits, evidence, and preparing for audit. Use this to design controls for a process, prepare for an external audit, respond to an audit finding, set approval thresholds, or assess where a small team's segregation of duties is genuinely broken.

copy.tagline: 设计并测试内控,为外部审计做好准备
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责财务内控,需要在审计前设计或测试控制。
copy.tagline_en: Design and test internal controls to prepare for your financial audit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you lead financial reporting and need controls that stand up to audit.

howto.what: Claude 会针对财务报告相关流程给出内部控制的设计与测试:提示审计要看的五个环节,说明审批上限、职责分离和留证据该怎么设,并指出小团队分工上的真实漏洞及可接受的补救办法。
howto.when: 当你要它为某项流程设计内部控制、准备外部审计、回应审计发现等场景时,就会触发。

say.text: 我司采购到付款由同一人完成,怎么设计补偿控制?
say.note: 它会按职责分离原则给出独立复核等做法。

say.text: 帮我为销售开票流程设定审批限额,并预防拆单。
say.note: 会考虑金额与风险,并建议监控临界交易。

say.text: 审计发现里要求加强审批,该怎么回应?
say.note: 会引导先修复原因,而非承诺更小心。

howto.what_en: Claude designs and tests controls over financial reporting: it covers five audit components, segregation of duties, approval limits, evidence, and visible compensating controls for small-team gaps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to design controls for a process, prepare for an external audit, respond to an audit finding, set approval thresholds, or assess a small team's segregation of duties.

say_en.text: One person handles purchase-to-pay; what compensating controls should we design?
say_en.note: It proposes independent review and monitoring.

say_en.text: Help me set approval limits for sales invoicing and prevent splitting.
say_en.note: It weighs value and risk, and flags threshold-splitting.

say_en.text: We got an audit finding on approvals; how should we respond?
say_en.note: It guides fixing the cause, not promising more care.
